title: Rasen Falcon owned LDAP service activation
delivered: Persistent Identity Directory recovery through NoSQLDirectoryStore
Secret Broker secretRef-to-environment mapping with no raw deployment secrets
Mandatory implicit TLS through OpenSSL/Foreign Runtime with no plaintext production fallback
Pre-install activation rehearsal for native LDAP wire, NoSQL restart recovery, STARTTLS/LDAPS and Access Permissions
Principal-isolation and revocation admission regression for human, CHATGPT and CLAUDE
consumer_contract: Website private admission requires ACTIVE attributed principal plus explicit HTTPS_LOGIN authority.
Mail read requires explicit MAIL_READ authority.
SMTP send requires explicit EMAIL_SEND authority; Bind and signature do not grant EMAIL_SEND.
Revoked principals fail service admission before the protected action.
authority: LDAP Identity owns identity semantics and LDAP conversation behavior.
General ooRexx Deployment owns sealed staging/install mechanics.
Rasen Falcon delivery owns activation and acceptance.
Crypto/PKI owns sign/verify/revoke; LDAP does not acquire signing authority.
live_gates: Install the owned service through General Deployment with the accepted dependency namespace and private-CA TLS material.
Provision durable directory state through reviewed provisioning authority; daemon startup never creates identities or ACLs.
Run ready:ldap_bind and e2e:ldap_revoke against the live owned service.
Run website HTTPS_LOGIN and mail MAIL_READ/EMAIL_SEND consumer probes against the same principal/revocation state.
non_claims: Production LDAP is not installed by this source contribution.
Fresh full ooRexx r13196 activation execution is not claimed from the construction container.
No third-party LDAP daemon is used.
